edits.name: Blink
edits.label: 闪现
edits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE new standalone transparent game HUD icon for the Ground mech's Blink / short teleport ability, replacing the previous arrow design.
Input Image 1 is the current production Ground mech A4B2 SHAPE REFERENCE: use the mech only, never the background, presentation layout, lettering or annotation. Simplify its recognizable chunky ground-mech silhouette and large mechanical shapes for an icon. Input Image 2 is only the RENDERING STYLE REFERENCE from the other icons: substantial 3D volume, bevels, clean broad surfaces, hard-edged cel shading and dark outlines. Do not include its bullet.
Required elements are ALL clearly readable: ONE solid dimensional mech in a forward dash pose, TWO offset fading mech-silhouette afterimages trailing behind it, and ONE prominent angular lightning bolt integrated diagonally with the direction of motion. Main mech at the forward/right side, afterimages extending to the rear/left. Compact balanced composition; the lightning bolt and the mech both remain identifiable at small HUD sizes. Pose and effects may be simplified; keep the reference mech's general identity, not a human, vehicle, Gundam head or a generic arrow.
Palette explicitly requested by user: PALE BLUE. Main armor in light icy sky blue, near-white highlights, slate-blue shadows, deep navy outlines; lightning in icy blue/white with pale cyan facets. Afterimages are less opaque blue silhouettes, each clearly separated and progressively fainter. No green, no purple/magenta arrow, no orange fire.
Render as a polished 3D cel-shaded object illustration: exactly THREE distinct hard-edged highlight/middle/shadow tone groups per opaque material, upper-left key light, strong crisp dark silhouette outline and sparse internal lines. No photorealism, no surface texture noise, no tiny greebles, no broad fuzzy bloom. Maintain the 3D+toon+outline visual language of the icon set.
One complete isolated icon, high-resolution square canvas, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, 12 percent breathing room, no cropping of any limb, lightning tip or afterimage. NO text, numerals, UI frame, button, badge, keys, background scene, floor, checkerboard painted into pixels, title, watermark, or multiple panels.
